config.question: current relative habitat suitability (not range shift, not migration, not climate causality)
config.background: target-group: all cells with any accepted handbook record, minus the focal species' cells
config.weighting: presence and background each 50% of total weight (MaxEnt unweighted)
config.screening: Spearman |rho|>0.7 in priority order, then iterative VIF<10 (drop the lowest-priority variable with VIF>=10), on the background sample
metrics: TSS: max over thresholds on the test fold (biomod2-comparable)
tss_train_threshold: TSS at the max-TSS threshold estimated on training data (stricter)
config.ensemble: weighted mean of algorithms with CV AUC >= 0.7; weight ∝ AUC-0.5

hyperparameters.GAM: additive cubic regression splines (5 knots) per predictor, L2-penalised logistic (C=0.5); pygam diverged
hyperparameters.BRT: HistGradientBoosting lr 0.03, 400 iterations, depth 5, min leaf 10, L2 1.0 (stack v2; GradientBoosting was too slow for 12 projections)

references: Karger D.N. et al. (2017) Sci Data 4:170122, doi:10.1038/sdata.2017.122
Phillips S.J. et al. (2009) Ecol Appl 19:181-197 (target-group background)
